seo.title: Rosewood Mayakoba: Lagoon Suite Honeymoon Review 2026
seo.description: 129 lagoon and beach suites in a private mangrove canal estate. Score 91/100, from $1100/night. Honest verdict, best suite, 7-night itinerary.

content.verdict: Rosewood Mayakoba is the anchor of the Mayakoba estate — 129 suites and villas spread across a private island of mangrove canals on the Riviera Maya, all accessed by silent electric boat from the central wharf. It is the most architecturally distinctive resort in Mexico and, for a decade, the consensus best honeymoon hotel in the Yucatán. The Lagoon Studio Suites — 134 m² with private terrace, plunge pool, and a path running directly into the mangrove canal — are why couples come here. The Sense spa occupies its own island reached by boat, with one of the best couples' temazcal (Mayan steam ritual) experiences anywhere. There are three restaurants, including the chef's table at Casa del Lago and Punta Bonita on the beach. The Mayakoba beach is private, raked daily, and protected by serious sargassum barriers — one of the genuinely sargassum-managed properties on the coast. The kids-club, while present, is invisible to honeymoon guests; couples are routed to the adult Beach Pool and the lagoon side. Caveats: the resort is large, you take electric boats everywhere, and the price has risen sharply since 2022. But the combination of architectural ambition, mangrove privacy, the Sense spa, and the Mayakoba beach standard makes Rosewood the safest serious-luxury honeymoon choice on the Yucatán coast. The defining moment is the sunset electric boat ride back from dinner along the mangrove canal with the parrots calling and the candles lit along the dock.
content.best_room: The Lagoon Studio Suite with private plunge pool and direct mangrove access — 134 m², swing chair on the terrace, and the canal water lapping the deck. Step up to the Overwater Lagoon Suite for the over-water palafito experience. Beach Suites are larger but lack the canal intimacy. Avoid garden-view category — you miss the entire Mayakoba point.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Arrival via Cancún
itinerary_7_nights.description: Cancún (CUN) to Mayakoba 50-min private transfer. Greet at the central wharf, electric boat to your Lagoon Studio. Champagne and Mexican wedding amaranth bars in-room. Dinner at Casa del Lago on the lagoon terrace.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Beach and Sense spa
itinerary_7_nights.description: Slow morning at Punta Bonita beach club. Lunch — fresh ceviche on the sand. Afternoon couples' temazcal ritual at Sense spa (3.5h, includes pre-treatment Mayan plant tea, the steam ceremony, and a post-treatment rest by the cenote pool). Sunset cocktails on your terrace.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Tulum ruins and Hartwood dinner
itinerary_7_nights.description: 8am private transfer to Tulum ruins (1h south). Private guide for the cliff-top archaeological site. Lunch at Be Tulum beach club. Return to Mayakoba mid-afternoon. Dinner at Hartwood in Tulum that evening (book 30 days ahead).

itinerary_7_nights.title: Gran Cenote private guided dive
itinerary_7_nights.description: Hotel arranges private guide and PADI dive at Gran Cenote near Tulum (1h south). Snorkel option if not certified. Picnic lunch at the cenote. Return to Mayakoba for spa-and-pool afternoon. Dinner at Punta Bonita on the beach.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Sian Ka'an biosphere day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Private boat with CESiaK from Muyil — drift-snorkel through the ancient Mayan canal, lunch in the biosphere, return mid-afternoon. Sunset and dinner in-suite (private chef can be arranged for the terrace).

itinerary_7_nights.title: Spa, beach, and Casa Banyan
itinerary_7_nights.description: Slow morning. Long lunch at the beach club. Couples' massage at Sense in the afternoon. Final dinner at Casa Banyan over at the Rosewood-affiliated villa for the tableside guacamole and lagoon view.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Slow departure
itinerary_7_nights.description: Breakfast on your private dock — fresh tropical fruit, sweet bread, Mayan hot chocolate. Final swim in the plunge pool. Electric boat to the wharf and private transfer back to CUN.

caveats: Lagoon Studio Suites book 6+ months ahead for November–April honeymoon peak.
The resort is large — 240 acres — and you depend on electric boats for everything. Romantic but slower than walking.
Sargassum barriers help but are not perfect; the Mayakoba beach can still have light seaweed in unusual current periods.
Three restaurants total — limited variety for a 7-night stay. Plan Tulum dinner excursions for variety.
Kids-club is present but invisible to honeymooners — note however that family guests do stay here in school holidays.

faqs.question: Good for honeymooners?
faqs.answer: Outstanding — the Lagoon Studio Suites with plunge pool and canal access are among the most romantic accommodations in the Caribbean. Most polished and architecturally serious option on the Riviera Maya.

faqs.question: Best time to visit?
faqs.answer: November to mid-April is the only correct window — outside that, hurricane risk and sargassum make even Rosewood's barriers struggle. November is the secret-best month for value.

faqs.question: Book in advance?
faqs.answer: 6+ months for Lagoon Studio Suites with plunge pool in November–April. Overwater Lagoon Suites sell out 9 months ahead for February and Easter.

faqs.question: Adults-only?
faqs.answer: No, families are present in school holidays. But the Lagoon Studios and adult Beach Pool are de facto adult zones and the property is designed so families and honeymooners rarely overlap.

faqs.question: Best room type?
faqs.answer: Lagoon Studio with plunge pool for the defining Mayakoba experience. Overwater Lagoon Suite for the palafito honeymoon dream. Beach Suite for direct beach access.

faqs.question: How to get there?
faqs.answer: Fly to Cancún International (CUN). Hotel arranges private transfer ($150–$220 per car each way, 50 min). Tulum airport (TQO) is closer but with limited flight routes.
